in_sanskrit.name: वासव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Basava is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vasu', which means 'to dwell'. The suffix 'ba' is added to denote the possessor, thus 'Basava' means 'Lord of all'.

in_hindi.name: बासव
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Basava in Hindi can be translated as 'The administrator of living beings'.

in_tamil.name: பாசவ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Basava can be translated as 'He who is both giver and taker' or 'He who is both present and absent'.

in_telugu.name: బాశవ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu name Basava can be translated as 'The ruler and protector of the people'.

in_marathi.name: Basava
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Basava हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has mastered the Vedas and Shastras, the God of Knowledge and Learning

in_bengali.name: Basava
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Knowledge
in_bengali.long_meaning: Basava একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has mastered the Vedas and Shastras, the God of Knowledge and Learning
